name: 27988-shortprefill-qwen8b-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, bf16, ~16 GB of weights (5 safetensors shards). Apache-2.0, ungated.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1). One card, the whole model on it, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1. Nothing is sharded.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 4096 requests with a 900 s safety cap -- roughly 3072 scored requests and a run of order two minutes.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix and no prefix bucket. Every request is exactly 32 prompt tokens in and exactly 16 tokens out, with no stdev on either, `ignore_eos: true` and `temperature: 0.0` sent in the request body.
purpose: A short-answer autocomplete service on an 8-billion-parameter model, serving four concurrent users from a single GPU.
launch:
# The sglang launch arguments for the engine named by configs/setupcard.md.
# Flat `key: value` only -- the parser DROPS nested and indented blocks, so a structured value
# must stay on one line or the engine starts without it.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tp-size: 1
attention-backend: flashinfer
prefill-max-requests: 16
disable-radix-cache: true
